description: Header file defining classes and interfaces for calculator snapshot management in the CalculatorApp ViewModel, including command representations, history items, and snapshot structures.

classes.name: UnaryCommand
classes.description: Represents a unary operation command with a list of command IDs.

classes.name: BinaryCommand
classes.description: Represents a binary operation command with a single command ID.

classes.name: OperandCommand
classes.description: Represents an operand with properties for negativity, decimal, scientific notation, and command list.

classes.name: Parentheses
classes.description: Represents parentheses command with a command ID.

classes.name: CalcManagerToken
classes.description: Token representing an operation code and its index.

classes.name: CalcManagerHistoryItem
classes.description: Stores a history item with tokens, commands, expression, and result.

classes.name: PrimaryDisplaySnapshot
classes.description: Snapshot of the primary display value and error state.

classes.name: ExpressionDisplaySnapshot
classes.description: Snapshot of expression tokens and commands.

classes.name: StandardCalculatorSnapshot
classes.description: Snapshot of calculator state including history, display, and commands.

classes.name: ApplicationSnapshot
classes.description: Snapshot of application mode and calculator state.

methods.name: CreateExprCommand
methods.description: Creates an expression command object from a given expression command.

methods.name: ToUnderlying
methods.description: Converts a vector of expression commands or history items to their underlying shared pointer representations.
